product_metadata.title: Elegant Comfort Penelopie Jacquard Look Curtain Panel Set with Attached Waterfall Valance, Set of 2, 54 x 84 Inches, Mauve
features: DESIGN AND STRUCTURE - Includes 2 panels. Each Panel measuring 54 inch wide by 84 inch long with 18" Attached Austrian Valance. For perfect look use one panel for every 32 Inches of your windows. Easy-to-install design featuring rod pocket style panel - HEAVY WEIGHT Material: 100% Polyester
QUALITY MATERIAL: Quality and durability are what you will get with this luxury heavyweight window curtain set. All fits on 1 rod for easy installation
Material: 100% Polyester - Easy care machine wash and line dry
ELEGANT COMFORT - We are here for refreshing your room! Bring the elegance of the royal family to your home, with these jacquard panels with attached valance.

MONEY BACK GUARANTEED: We think you're going to love this Luxury Window Curtain as much as we do! But in case you don't, you are covered by our 30 day, no questions asked, money back guarantee. We want our customers to be 100% happy.
description: Experience the luxury curtains, and beauty of one-of-a-kind these Elegant curtains - A collection of window panels that deliver both fashion and function for the home. The innovative jacquard look weave is designed without comprising style. Whether you are looking to enhance your existing decor or going for a complete room makeover, these luxury panels are versatile enough to enhance any space. Put these window panels to work anywhere in your home. Hang them in your living room or in the nursery or kids room to decor your room. While you love those big, bright, beautiful windows, sometimes you'd like an option for making the room a little cozier by keeping the sun out of your eyes. You can do it in a way that adds a touch of modern style to your home decor. Featuring an incredible array of colors to choose from, this beautiful window panel set is the perfect way to dress your home with beauty, sophistication, and up-to-the moment style. Sweeten up your decorating with these lustrous, easy-to-install curtains. Hang two or more window panels on a standard or decorative rod for optimal coverage. Rods sold separately. 100-percent Polyester. Machine wash, tumble dry, do not bleach.
